readerCopy.body: A small act of care can bring up more emotion than the favor itself seems large enough to explain. When the Moon conjoins Chiron, care and sensitivity fuse, allowing a meal, ride, check-in, or somebody taking a task off the list to touch the history of having to manage the same need alone. The reaction does not make the kindness a problem. Present help can be useful even when it arrives with the memory of what was missing before.
